full_judgment: Syed Md Dastagir Husain J: This death reference is referred under section 374 of the Code of Criminal Procedure by the Additional Sessions Judge, Lakshmipur for confirmation of the sentence to death of condemned prisoner Amir Hossain @ Shona Miah, Most. Halima Begum, Delwar Hossain @ Shohel, Abdul Matin, Md Montaz Uddin Ahmed and Abdul Khaleq Patowary and Criminal Appeal No. 687 of 2007 preferred by the condemned prisoner/ appellant 1. Amir Hossain @ Shona Miah, 2. Most Halima Begum, 3. Delwar Hossain Shohel 4. Abdul Matin 5.Md Montaz Uddin. Ahmed 6. Abdul Jalil 7. Rasheda Begum and 8. Monawara Begum and Jail Appeal No. 141 of 2007 preferred by the condemned prisoner Montazuddin Ahmed, Jail Appeal No. 142 of 2007 preferred by the condemned prisoner Abdul Matin, Jail Appeal No. 143 of 2007 preferred by the condemned prisoner Amir Hossain, Jail Appeal No. 144 of 2007 preferred by the condemned prisoner Delower Hossain Sohel, Jail Appeal No. 145 of 2007 preferred by the condemned prisoner Halima Khatun, Jail Appeal No. 146 of 2007 preferred by the convict appellant A Jalil, Jail Appeal No. 147 of 2007 preferred by the convict appellant Rasheda Begum and Jail Appeal No. 148 of 2007 preferred by the convict appellant Monowara is directed against the Judgment and order dated 26-2-2007 passed by Additional Sessions Judge, Lakshmipur in Sessions Case No. 19 of 1998 arising out of Lakshmipur Police Station case No. 5 dated 12-6-1994 corresponding to GR No. 162 of 1994 convicting the appellant Nos. 1 to 5 under section 302 and 114 of the Penal Code and sentencing them to death and further convicting the appellant Nos. 6 to 8 under section 302 and 114 of the Penal Code and sentencing them to suffer rigorous imprisonment for life and to pay a fine of Tk. 10,000 each in default to suffer rigorous imprisonment for one year more.
